Cross the caves north of Carlin and the dangerous {wiki:Maze of Lost Souls} to {wiki:Demona}, the lair of the {creature:Warlock|Warlocks}. In the quest room, guarded by Warlocks and Dragons, you open the chests to receive a {item:Crystal Wand}, a {item:Silver Rune Emblem (Sudden Death)} and the book {item:Twinkiller Rune (Book)}.
Minimum level 60 to pass the Gate of Expertise (70+ recommended).

Exploring the Maze of Lost Souls without a map is very dangerous: follow the route images step by step and do not leave the path if you cannot handle {creature:Dragon|Dragons}, {creature:Dragon Lord|Dragon Lords} and {creature:Giant Spider|Giant Spiders}.
On the way you will meet all sorts, from {creature:Rat|Rats} to {creature:Orc Leader|Orc Leaders}.
1. Get to the Maze of Lost Souls entrance

There are several caves north of Carlin, in the {wiki:Fields of Glory}, that lead to the Maze of Lost Souls (MoLS). This guide starts at the cave a little south of {wiki:Northport}, a small village north of Carlin.
Go to the cave south of Northport

Start from **Carlin** (if you come by boat, say {key:hi}, {key:carlin}, {key:yes} to your city's captain; you arrive at {npc:Captain Greyhound}). Leave the city to the **north**, through the {wiki:Fields of Glory}, and head **northeast** to {wiki:Northport}, a small village northeast of Carlin. The cave is a little **south** of Northport.
Open the hole with the shovel
Use the {item:Shovel} to open a hole at this spot and go in.
Follow the **blue line** on the map to the next hole.
Route to the next hole (blue line)

Keep following the blue line until you find a small grove inside the cave. At the **red** spot, behind the trees, there is a hole. Go down and, once inside, flip the lever to the **right** to open the MoLS entrance.
Red spot: hole with the lever, behind the trees
If the lever is already flipped to the right, flip it to the left and then to the right again.
Leave the hole and follow this path to the entrance of the Maze of Lost Souls. You will have to cross a few {item:Energy Field|Energy Fields}.
Energy Fields take health when you cross them: have full health.
Follow the map inside the MoLS
Once inside the Maze of Lost Souls, follow the map step by step.
Safe route inside the Maze of Lost Souls
If you leave the path you may run into {creature:Dragon|Dragons}, {creature:Dragon Lord|Dragon Lords} and {creature:Giant Spider|Giant Spiders}.

The {wiki:Griffin Shield Quest} is in the first entrance room; if you have not done it yet, you can take the opportunity now. Here you meet 3 {creature:Elf Arcanist|Elf Arcanists}, 2 {creature:Stone Golem|Stone Golems}, 2 {creature:Dwarf Guard|Dwarf Guards} and 2 {creature:Minotaur Guard|Minotaur Guards}.
Keep going to the end of the passage and go through the level 60 **Gate of Expertise**.
Go **north** and always take the **right-hand** passage until the stairs. {wiki:Demona} is right above.

In Demona there are several {creature:Warlock|Warlocks}, a couple of {creature:Stone Golem|Stone Golems} and some {creature:Elf Arcanist|Elf Arcanists}. Go to the top of the room and go down the stairs to the quest room.
Warlocks are very dangerous: they cast strong magic and summon creatures.

In the quest room there are **4 {creature:Warlock|Warlocks}** and **5 {creature:Dragon|Dragons}**. Kill them or keep them away, go to the **north** side of the room and open the {item:Chest (Quest)|chests}: one has the {item:Crystal Wand} and another has a bag ({item:Bag}) with the {item:Silver Rune Emblem (Sudden Death)} and the {item:Twinkiller Rune (Book)}.
The books in the quest room may also be worth taking.
4. Leave the Maze of Lost Souls

To leave the MoLS, follow the path on this map: there are other exits, but this one is the safest and the shortest. Then leave the cave the **same way** you came in (the maps from section 1 in reverse), using the {item:Rope} to climb up the holes, to the surface near Northport. From there go back **southwest**, through the Fields of Glory, to Carlin.
Exit route from the Maze of Lost Souls
Alternative: teleport to the Fields of Glory

If you are comfortable hunting in Demona, go **northwest** of the Star Room (the room with the Warlocks) and go down these stairs (nothing spawns right next to the stairs). From the stairs walk **north** and then **west**: you meet 2 {creature:Warlock|Warlocks} and 2 {creature:Elf Arcanist|Elf Arcanists}. Keep going west to the end of the tunnel and then head **south**. At the end of that corridor there is a teleport that takes you back to the {wiki:Fields of Glory}. From there walk back **south** to Carlin.
Stairs northwest of the Star Room
Teleport to the Fields of Glory
On this path you may meet many of the creatures in the area, such as {creature:Warlock|Warlocks}.
